payload.title: The stored-proof replay of the tenant-erasure proof (storedProofToEvent, assertStoredProofMode, numberFromRow, isoFromRow) exists as two private copies, one in farm-service TenantErasureService and one in backend-common TenantErasureTargetExecutor, and nothing makes them build the same event.
evidence: apps/farm-service/src/compliance/services/tenant-erasure.service.ts:765-787 (farm copy of storedProofToEvent, calls restoreEventId and builds TenantDataErasedEvent field by field)
libs/backend-common/src/compliance/tenant-erasure/tenant-erasure-target-executor.ts:752-774 (executor copy, same fields, only targetService differs)
apps/farm-service/src/compliance/services/tenant-erasure.service.ts:749-763 (farm assertStoredProofMode, message without the operation id)
libs/backend-common/src/compliance/tenant-erasure/tenant-erasure-target-executor.ts:730-750 (executor assertStoredProofMode, same checks, messages that name the operation id)
payload.rule_violated: One owner per fact: a replayed erasure proof is one concept with two private implementations (CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach, root-cause only; the platform rule of one centre and no duplicates).
payload.notes: Both bodies convert a TenantErasureStoredProofRow into the TenantDataErasedEvent that is re-enqueued on replay. They have already diverged in their error texts, and the two copies were fixed separately for tenant scoping (FARM-HIGH-081 for the service, PLAT-CRITICAL-923 for the executor). When TenantDataErasedEvent or the ledger row gains a field that is optional on the type, an engineer who edits one copy leaves the other emitting the old shape, so the same stored GDPR proof re-enqueued through farm-service differs from the one re-enqueued by the executor; the compiler only flags a missing required field. The new restoreEventId validation sits in both copies and must also be changed twice. Close condition: Move the row-to-event conversion and its helpers into one function in libs/backend-common/src/compliance/tenant-erasure/ that takes the target service, call it from both sites and delete both private copies. Proven by one spec that feeds the same stored proof row through the farm replay and the executor replay and asserts equal events, plus an invariant that exactly one non-test production file calls restoreEventId on a stored proof row. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 5). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
